product_metadata.title: iDesign Orbinni Wall Mounted Metal Paper Towel Holder, Roll Organizer for Kitchen, Bathroom, Craft Room, Satin Silver
features: WALL MOUNTED PAPER TOWEL HOLDER: Keep paper towels within arm's reach in your kitchen, bathroom, craft room, or workspace. Wall mounted design looks great anywhere!
DURABLE: Metal construction is rust-resistant and durable for years of use
STYLISH: Satin silver finish is fashionable and matches a variety of kitchen decor styles
INCLUDED HARDWARE: Includes all necessary mounting hardware for your convenience
IDEAL SIZE: Paper towel holder measures 13.75" x 2.5" x 4.25" for use in any kitchen
description: Add a classic look to your kitchen with the iDesign Orbinni Paper Towel Holder. Constructed of rust-resistant steel, this paper towel holder is built to last. The organizer mounts to the wall with included hardware to always keep paper towel within reach. With a stylish satin silver finish and modern design, you can easily match the holder to your kitchen decor. Simply move the center bar to add a new roll of paper towel. Paper towel holder measures 13.75" x 2.5" x 4.25". With iDesign by InterDesign, you can #LiveSimply every day.
